name: example-parallel-implement-review-quickstart
goal: Demonstrate a real parallel implementer run plus reviewed promotion against the Spring Boot quickstart example.

sharedContext.summary: Add a new quickstart endpoint `GET /api/employees/by-department?department=Engineering&limit=2` that returns `EmployeeView` rows for the exact department, ordered by salary descending, with `limit` defaulting to 10 and capped at 25. Keep the change bounded to the quickstart example and make the reviewer inspect the combined upstream changes before promotion.
constraints: Keep work bounded to the Spring Boot starter quickstart example.
Do not edit TODO.md, ai/state files, ai/log files, or ai/indexes.
Task write scopes must stay disjoint so the two implementers can run in parallel.

tasks.title: Implement the quickstart department endpoint
tasks.prompt: Implement `GET /api/employees/by-department`. Reuse the existing in-memory employee dataset and return `EmployeeView` rows filtered by exact department match, sorted by salary descending, with `limit` defaulting to 10 and capped at 25.

tasks.title: Document and test the quickstart department endpoint
tasks.prompt: Using the shared endpoint contract, update the quickstart README curl examples and add focused default plus virtual-thread integration coverage for `GET /api/employees/by-department?department=Engineering&limit=2`. Assume the endpoint returns `EmployeeView` rows sorted by salary descending with `limit` default 10 and max 25.

tasks.title: Review the combined quickstart department change
tasks.prompt: Review the combined quickstart department-endpoint change for correctness, test sufficiency, and whether the README contract matches the implementation. Focus on regressions, missing validation, and promotion risks.
